title: Telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tripod legs -->
  <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="28" y2="94" stroke="#7ee6ff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="72" y2="94" stroke="#7ee6ff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="50" y2="94" stroke="#55cce8" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Tripod connector -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="6" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="3" fill="#ffd98a"/>
  
  <!-- Telescope tube back -->
  <rect x="14" y="34" width="56" height="16" rx="8" fill="#4a7ebb" transform="rotate(-20 42 42)"/>
  <rect x="14" y="34" width="56" height="16" rx="8" fill="#6fa8dc" transform="rotate(-20 42 42)" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Main tube -->
  <rect x="22" y="36" width="52" height="14" rx="7" fill="#6fa8dc" transform="rotate(-20 48 43)"/>
  
  <!-- Tube highlight -->
  <rect x="26" y="38" width="44" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#a8d4f0" transform="rotate(-20 48 43)" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Eyepiece -->
  <rect x="70" y="20" width="12" height="10" rx="3" fill="#ffb347" transform="rotate(-20 76 25)"/>
  <rect x="72" y="21" width="8" height="4" rx="2" fill="#ffd98a" transform="rotate(-20 76 25)"/>
  
  <!-- Front lens rim -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="44" rx="5" ry="11" fill="#3d6699" transform="rotate(-20 22 44)"/>
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="44" rx="3" ry="8" fill="#8ec6f0" transform="rotate(-20 22 44)"/>
  
  <!-- Lens glow -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="44" rx="2" ry="5" fill="#cceeff" transform="rotate(-20 22 44)" opacity="0.8"/>
  
  <!-- Star in lens -->
  <circle cx="21" cy="41" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- Small stars around -->
  <circle cx="15" cy="28" r="1" fill="#fff9a0"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="18" r="1.2" fill="#fff9a0"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="64" r="1" fill="#fff9a0"/>
</svg>
